process.title: Free growth call
process.text: Tell us about your business and your goals. We’ll tell you honestly what will help, even if that means not hiring us.

process.title: Your plan and fixed price
process.text: You get a written plan: what we’ll build, when it will be ready and exactly what it costs. No surprises later.

process.title: We build, deploy and launch
process.text: See progress every week and approve each stage before paying for it. We deploy it into your business, then stay on to fix anything, free.

faqs.q: I’m not technical. Will I understand what’s going on?
faqs.a: Yes. We explain everything in plain English, show you progress every week, and never ask you to make a technical decision without telling you what it means for your business.

faqs.q: What can AI automation actually do for my business?
faqs.a: Anything repetitive: answering common questions, qualifying leads, booking calls, sending follow ups and reminders, creating invoices, and keeping your CRM and spreadsheets up to date. We map your week, find the tasks eating the most hours, and automate those first.

faqs.q: Is it safe to let AI talk to my customers?
faqs.a: Yes. Your AI only answers from information you approve, hands tricky conversations to you, and is tested before it goes live. We deploy it, monitor it every day, and you can switch it off any time.

faqs.q: How much does a website cost?
faqs.a: Most small business websites start from $700 and go live in 1 to 3 weeks. Online stores, AI assistants and apps cost more, depending on what you need. Either way, you get an exact, fixed price in writing before you commit to anything.

faqs.q: I’ve been burned by a freelancer before. How is this different?
faqs.a: Your money is held in Upwork or Fiverr escrow and only released when you approve each stage of the work. You see real progress every week, and everything we build is in your name from day one. You never pay for promises.

faqs.q: What if I don’t like the design?
faqs.a: You see the design before we build anything, and two rounds of changes are included at every stage. If the first direction misses, we rework it at no extra cost.
Completely. The website, the domain, the code and every account are in your name from the start. No lock in, and no paying us just to get access to your own site.

faqs.q: Do you work with businesses outside the US?
faqs.a: Yes. Most of our clients are in the US, and we also work with businesses in the UK, Europe, the Middle East and beyond. We overlap with US business hours every working day.

Every project includes 30 to 90 days of free fixes, depending on your plan. After that you can add a monthly care plan from $99, or take it over yourself with the guides we hand over. Our Terms of Service have the full details.

faqs.q: How much will my project cost?
faqs.a: Most small business websites land between $700 and $2,500. Online stores, apps and AI assistants depend on what you need. After a free 30 minute call you get an exact, fixed price in writing, before you commit to anything.

faqs.q: Can you work with my budget?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us your budget on the call and we will shape the plan around it, by starting smaller, splitting the work into phases, or focusing first on whatever brings in customers fastest.

faqs.q: Which plan is right for me?
faqs.a: Launch suits new businesses and solo founders who need to get online fast. Grow suits established small businesses and online stores ready for more customers. Scale suits growing companies, software founders and agencies who need a team. Not sure? We will tell you honestly on the call.
No. Once you approve the written plan, the price is locked for that work. If you want to add something, we send you the cost first, and nothing happens without your OK. No surprise invoices.

The project is split into stages. You fund each stage through Upwork or Fiverr, the money is held safely in escrow, and it is only released when you approve the work. Larger projects can be invoiced monthly instead.

faqs.q: What are the bonuses and the value figures?
faqs.a: They are extras included in your price that most agencies charge for separately, shown with what they typically cost on their own. You don’t pay anything extra for them.
Free fixes for 30, 60 or 90 days depending on your plan, covering anything we built that doesn’t work as agreed. New features are quoted separately. The full wording is in our Terms of Service.

faqs.q: Do I need a monthly care plan?
faqs.a: It’s optional, but most businesses with a live website or store choose one. It keeps everything updated, backed up and fixed quickly. Cancel any time with 30 days’ notice.

faqs.q: Are hosting and other tools included?
faqs.a: No. Hosting, domains, Shopify plans and other tools are billed by their providers straight to your accounts, so you always own them. We estimate these costs in your plan and keep them as low as possible.
Yes. We are happy to sign an NDA before our first call if you need one.
